description: Compares ways of reading compound members for lemma search (documentation/compound-members-brief.md, documentation/compound-members-evaluation.md). Run: PROCESS_SANSKRIT_DCS_CONLLU_DIR=/path/to/dcs/conllu/files uv run python scripts/evaluate_compound_members.py

brief.description: What the brief names: the library's preverbs, the negative prefix and the two abstract suffixes.

member-affixes.description: For Monier-Williams' own `—` members (not in the brief): the library's preverbs, the particles su/ku/sa/dus/nis, and the suffixes DCS does not treat as words (-tva, -tā, -mat, -tas, -tara, -tama, -śas); not -vat or -maya, which DCS and lemma mode split as words.

extended.description: What the library uses (utils/compoundMembers.py, AffixFilter.default): runs of preverbs in their sandhi spellings (PreverbSandhi.spellings), except a run of two or more that is a Sanskrit headword (samādhi, vipra), the particles and suffixes of MEMBER_PARTICLES / MEMBER_SUFFIXES (utils/lexicalResources.py), and pieces that must spell the headword.

variants.name: baseline
variants.description: The library rule: Monier-Williams `—`, the reading most entries give (rule 9).

variants.name: p1-bhs
variants.description: Point 1: Edgerton's `-` for headwords Monier-Williams lacks; extended filters.

variants.name: p1-bhs-gra
variants.description: Point 1: Edgerton's, then Grassmann's `-` for headwords Monier-Williams lacks; extended filters.

variants.name: p1-bhs-gra-brief-filters
variants.description: Point 1 as p1-bhs-gra, with only the filters the brief names.

variants.name: p1-loose
variants.description: Point 1, loose reading: the fallback also when Monier-Williams has the word but its vote gives no members; extended filters.

variants.name: p1-loose-brief-filters
variants.description: Point 1 as the brief words it: loose condition, the filters it names.

variants.name: p2-xref
variants.description: Point 2: Monier-Williams' 'in compound for X' entries put members in lemma form (taj -> tad, mano -> manas), for stubs that are mostly such entries (not mahā, para, dharma).

variants.name: p2-xref-guarded
variants.description: Point 2, guarded: also only when lemma mode gives X as a lemma of the stub in the pausa spelling a split piece has (manas of manaḥ, not ātman of ātma).

variants.name: p3-hyphens
variants.description: Point 3: a Monier-Williams `-` between two Sanskrit headwords is a member boundary; preverbs and suffixes are not.

variants.name: p3-hyphens-min3
variants.description: Point 3 with both pieces at least three letters long, so that nṛ-pa or dvi-ja is not cut.

variants.name: p3-hyphens-any-left
variants.description: Point 3, also when the piece before the `-` is no headword (sarvābharaṇa-bhūṣita).

variants.name: p4-ties
variants.description: Point 4: a tie between a compound reading and no compound gives the compound's members.

variants.name: p5-junction
variants.description: Merged-vowel repair (known-errors.md section 2): a pair with a side that is no headword is read again at its sandhi junction (JunctionSandhi); a pair no reading makes words of keeps Monier-Williams' cut.

variants.name: p5-junction-drop
variants.description: p5-junction, but a pair no reading makes words of costs the headword its members (the rule of 2026-11-22).

variants.name: p5-vowel-always
variants.description: p5-junction that also restores a vowel before a second member that is a word (mahā+tman -> mahā+ātman, but mahā+kāla -> mahā+akāla).

variants.name: p6-mw-affixes
variants.description: Not in the brief: its rule that a prefix or suffix is not a member, applied to Monier-Williams' own `—` (tat—tva, dhī—mat, dur—yodhana); extended filters.

variants.name: p6-mw-affixes-narrow
variants.description: p6 with the member-affixes profile: only affixes DCS does not treat as words.

variants.name: brief-literal
variants.description: Everything the brief asks, read literally: loose fallback with its filters, unguarded xref, `-` between words, ties.

variants.name: conservative
variants.description: What lemma mode ships: strict fallback with extended filters, guarded xref, junction repair keeping Monier-Williams' cut when no reading helps; no `-`, no ties.

variants.name: conservative-drop
variants.description: conservative, but a pair no reading makes words of costs the headword its members.

variants.name: conservative-hyphens
variants.description: conservative plus Monier-Williams `-` between two headwords.

variants.name: conservative-hyphens-min3
variants.description: conservative plus Monier-Williams `-` between two headwords of at least three letters.

variants.name: conservative-affixes
variants.description: conservative plus p6: prefixes and suffixes glued back in Monier-Williams' members.

variants.name: conservative-affixes-narrow
variants.description: conservative plus p6-mw-affixes-narrow.
